parts.name: Fan
parts.Basic_description: This is the fan blade assembly of a ceiling fan, made of wood. It consists of multiple blades attached to a central hub.
parts.Functional_description: The fan blades rotate to circulate air and create airflow in the room.
parts.Movement_description: The fan blades rotate around the central axis when powered by the motor.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the ceiling fan, made of metal. It includes the motor housing and the ceiling mount.
parts.Functional_description: The base body houses the motor and supports the fan blades, providing structural stability and power transmission.
parts.Movement_description: The base body remains stationary while supporting the rotating fan blades.
